method.row_count: count of data rows in input/operations.csv, excluding the header row
method.completion_percent: completed_orders / work_orders * 100, computed from integer subtotals then rounded to 2 decimals
method.minutes_per_completed_order: actual_minutes / completed_orders, computed from integer subtotals then rounded to 2 decimals
method.schedule_variance_minutes: actual_minutes - planned_minutes (positive means over the planned minutes)
method.derivation_order: integer sums per team were accumulated from the 18 raw rows; overall totals are the sum of the three team subtotals; both decimal metrics are derived only from integer sums, never from rounded intermediates
method.verification: Recomputed with a second independent pass over the 18 rows (vertical column sums); both passes agreed on every integer subtotal and both derived decimal metrics.
